title: Exodus Bible Quiz - Chapter 4
description: Ten questions on Exodus 4: the signs God gave Moses, Aaron as his spokesman and the return to Egypt.

questions.text: What did Moses' rod become when he threw it on the ground?
questions.explanation: Moses threw the rod on the ground, it became a snake, and Moses ran away from it.

questions.text: What happened to Moses' hand when he first took it out of his cloak?
questions.explanation: When he took his hand out of his cloak, it was leprous, as white as snow.

answers.text: It was leprous, as white as snow
It was withered and could not move

questions.text: What would happen to the river water Moses poured on the dry land?
questions.explanation: If the people did not believe the first two signs, Moses was to pour river water on the dry land, and it would become blood.

answers.text: It would dry up at once

questions.text: Why did Moses say he was not fit to speak?
questions.explanation: Moses said he was not eloquent, for he was slow of speech and of a slow tongue.

answers.text: He was slow of speech and of a slow tongue
He did not speak the Egyptian language
He was too old to travel
He was a wanted man in Egypt

questions.text: Whom did God appoint as Moses' spokesman to the people?
questions.explanation: God said Aaron, Moses' brother the Levite, could speak well and would be his spokesman to the people.

questions.text: Why did Yahweh tell Moses he could safely return to Egypt?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said to Moses in Midian, "Go, return into Egypt; for all the men who sought your life are dead."

answers.text: The Egyptian he killed had survived
The Israelites had already been freed
All the men who sought his life were dead

questions.text: What was Moses to tell Pharaoh that Yahweh calls Israel?
questions.explanation: Moses was to tell Pharaoh, "Yahweh says, Israel is my son, my firstborn."

questions.text: What did Zipporah use to circumcise her son?
questions.explanation: Zipporah took a flint, cut off the foreskin of her son and cast it at Moses' feet.
Yahweh told Aaron to go into the wilderness to meet Moses, and he met him on God's mountain and kissed him.

questions.text: How did the people respond when Aaron spoke and did the signs?
questions.explanation: The people believed, and when they heard that Yahweh had seen their affliction, they bowed their heads and worshiped.

answers.text: They laughed at Moses and Aaron
They told Pharaoh about the signs
